purpose: Full synchronized RGB, independent TCP policy, training reader and LeRobot consumer regression
selection: Known repaired three-cup regression; not a new holdout or population estimate
protocol: One complete physical task, all three native-resolution RGB streams at 30 Hz; no repeated preflight. Compare against the retained full state trajectory. No tuning, skipped images, speed editing, or acceptance relaxation. Keep failures and partial outputs.
storage: Volatile tmpfs for full raw/export validation; not a durable production release. No existing raw data is deleted. Archive required before reboot.
performance_scope: Profile full acquisition/audit/export on tmpfs; separate actual stage wall times from production disk throughput. A single known regression cannot establish qualified population throughput.
remaining_limitations: Uncalibrated camera/contact parameters and per-target finger material switching remain.
One accepted RGB episode would not demonstrate broad reliability or sim-to-real fidelity.
